verdict.rationale: PostHog's own docs describe using a flag as a kill switch: you turn it off the moment something looks wrong, with no redeploy or hotfix. Nothing in the pack says how quickly that change reaches connected SDKs or whether it arrives by streaming or polling. Missing for 10: documented streaming or polling delivery to SDKs, stated propagation latency (seconds), SDK refresh-interval configuration, independent or hands-on confirmation that kill switches take effect quickly.

support.subject: As a developer, flag changes propagate to connected SDKs in seconds via streaming or fast polling — a kill switch actually kills

citations.quote: turn it off the moment something looks wrong – no redeploy, no hotfix
